cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(tdt_passage_planner VERSION 2.0.0 LANGUAGES C CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE)
  set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE Release CACHE STRING "Build type" FORCE)
endif()
find_package(Eigen3 3.3 REQUIRED NO_MODULE)
find_package(nlohmann_json 3.2 REQUIRED)
# Only core + imgproc are used; image files are handled by stb. No Qt here.
find_path(TDT_OPENCV_INCLUDE opencv2/core.hpp PATH_SUFFIXES opencv4 REQUIRED)
find_library(TDT_OPENCV_CORE NAMES opencv_core REQUIRED)
find_library(TDT_OPENCV_IMGPROC NAMES opencv_imgproc REQUIRED)
set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OFF CACHE BOOL "Static bundled solvers" FORCE)
set(BUILD_TESTING OFF CACHE BOOL "Do not build solver tests" FORCE)
set(OSQP_BUILD_SHARED_LIB OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(OSQP_BUILD_STATIC_LIB ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(OSQP_BUILD_DEMO_EXE OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(OSQP_BUILD_UNITTESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(OSQP_CODEGEN OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(OSQP_IS_V1 ON)
set(OSQP_IS_V1_FINAL ON)
set(OSQP_EIGEN_DEBUG_OUTPUT OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(FETCHCONTENT_SOURCE_DIR_QDLDL "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/third_party/qdldl" CACHE PATH "Offline QDLDL" FORCE)
add_subdirectory(third_party/osqp EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
if(NOT TARGET osqp::osqpstatic)
  add_library(osqp::osqpstatic ALIAS osqpstatic)
endif()
set(OSQP_EIGEN_OSQP_TARGET_TO_LINK osqp::osqpstatic)
add_subdirectory(third_party/osqp-eigen EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
add_library(tdt_passage STATIC
  cpp/semantic_planner.cpp cpp/image_io.cpp
  tdt_core/YAstar/yastar.cpp
  tdt_core/YAstar/kinodynamicAstar.cpp
  tdt_core/MinimumSnapOsqp/minimumSnap.cpp
  tdt_core/MinimumSnapOsqp/sfcSquare.cpp)
target_include_directories(tdt_passage PUBLIC include tdt_core ${TDT_OPENCV_INCLUDE} PRIVATE third_party)
target_link_libraries(tdt_passage PUBLIC Eigen3::Eigen nlohmann_json::nlohmann_json OsqpEigen::OsqpEigen ${TDT_OPENCV_CORE} ${TDT_OPENCV_IMGPROC})
target_compile_options(tdt_passage PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wno-unused-parameter -Wno-missing-field-initializers)
option(TDT_BUILD_APPS "Build independent CLI and API example" ON)
if(TDT_BUILD_APPS)
  add_executable(passage_cli cpp/passage_cli.cpp)
  target_link_libraries(passage_cli PRIVATE tdt_passage)
  add_executable(passage_api_example examples/cpp_api_example.cpp)
  target_link_libraries(passage_api_example PRIVATE tdt_passage)
endif()
option(TDT_BUILD_TESTS "Build semantic planner regression tests" ON)
if(TDT_BUILD_TESTS)
  enable_testing()
  add_executable(passage_tests tests/planner_tests.cpp)
  target_link_libraries(passage_tests PRIVATE tdt_passage)
  add_test(NAME passage_core COMMAND passage_tests)
endif()
